Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 
 NULLchk;

 SELECT SUBSTR(company,1,30)
 ,center_id
 ,nvl(results_method,'A')
 INTO :control_block.company
 ,:control_block.center_id
 ,:control_block.results_method
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND --RP MLT# 262 06042018
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(:control_block.contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365);
 --FOR UPDATE OF contract_id NOWAIT -- V04
 /*only one user extracing for a customer at a time */
EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 show_error('1060');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO dummy
 FROM contracts
 WHERE --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND --RP MLT# 262 06042018
 UPPER(company) LIKE '%'||UPPER(:control_block.contract_id)||'%' AND 
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365) AND 
 ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 LIST_VALUES;
 GO_ITEM('control_block.contract_id');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN 
 BELL;
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;

END;

Block.Name: BATCH
Block.WhereClause:
where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and results_qc_date is not null
 and ((:GLOBAL.TWOTECH = 'Y' and
 decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, 1, 4),
 'OPS$',
 substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, 5),
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid) != results_qc_user or
 :GLOBAL.TWOTECH = 'N'))
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from rgt_result_parms ru
 where ru.batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id
 and ru.contract_id = batch_inputs.contract_id
 /*and ru.chapter_id = batch_inputs.chapter_id*/
 and nvl(under_extract_flag, 'Y') = 'Y')
 and exists (select 'x'
 from units u, utrs t
 where u.chapter_id = batch_inputs.chapter_id
 and u.contract_id = batch_inputs.contract_id
 and u.batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id
 and u.chapter_id = t.chapter_id
 and u.unit_id = t.unit_id
 and trunc(u.coll_date) = trunc(t.coll_date)
 and nvl(t.cancel_flag, 'N') = 'N'
 and t.extract_date is null
 AND 'Y' = (
 SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 0, 'Y', MAX(NVL(x.extract,'N')))
 FROM contract_tests x
 WHERE x.contract_id = batch_inputs.contract_id
 AND x.test_id = t.test_id
 )
 and test_id in
 (select test_id
 from valid_tests
 where test_group not in ('CNFRM', 'SUPP')))
 and exists (select 'x'
 from rgt_results_batch ru
 where ru.result_batch_id = batch_inputs.batch_id
 and ru.contract_id = batch_inputs.contract_id
 /*and ru.chapter_id = batch_inputs.chapter_id*/
 and ru.result_type = 'I'
 UNION
 select 'x'
 from dual
 where nvl(:result_type, 'X') != 'R')

Block.Name: UNITS
Block.WhereClause:
where chapter_id = :batch.chapter_id
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and batch_id = :batch.batch_id
 and exists
 (select 'x'
 from utrs
 where utrs.unit_id = units.unit_id
 and utrs.chapter_id = units.chapter_id
 and units.qc_test_flag in ('Y', 'T')
 and TRUNC(utrs.coll_date) = TRUNC(units.coll_date)
 and extract_date is null
 AND 'Y' = (
 SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 0, 'Y', MAX(NVL(x.extract,'N')))
 FROM contract_tests x
 WHERE x.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 AND x.test_id = utrs.test_id
 )
 and nvl(cancel_flag, 'N') = 'N'
 and not exists
 (select 'x'
 from valid_test_results
 where (confirm_test_id_1 = utrs.test_id or
 confirm_test_id_2 = utrs.test_id)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate)))

declare

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_RGT_PARM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure create_rgt_parm is
 selected VARCHAR2(1);
 start_rec number;
 l_sysdate DATE; -- V05
begin
 go_block('batch');
 start_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 first_record;
 selected := 'N';
 l_sysdate := SYSDATE; -- V05 (Use this variable to maintian constant date for the batches)
 loop
 if :batch.select = 'X'
 then
 selected := 'Y';
 begin
 /* Result type is taken as I , for initial extract */
 insert into rgt_result_parms
 (chapter_id,
 batch_id,
 contract_id,
 result_parm_id,
 unit_list,
 result_type,
 other_batches,
 under_extract_flag,
 insert_dats,
 insert_user_id)
 values
 (:control_block.chapter_id, -- V03 (this should be logged in chapter only)
 :batch.batch_id,
 :control_block.contract_id,
 :control_block.result_parm_id,
 nvl(:batch.unit_list_flag,'N'),
 :control_block.result_type,
 'N',
 'Y',
 l_sysdate, -- V05
 decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,4),'OPS$',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid));
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record(start_rec);
 if selected = 'N'
 then
 show_error('2186');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INIT_EXTRACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE init_extract 
IS
 /* generate the host commAND to run the report AND start it */
 szExtrLoc VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 program_name VARCHAR2(60) := NULL;
 in_file Text_IO.File_Type;
 t_file_name VARCHAR2(200);
 v_after_time_gmt DATE;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
 t_pp_id varchar2(4);
 t_status varchar2(200);
 lv_report_id VARCHAR2(20); -- SCR 19037
 lv_pp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 unit_cnt NUMBER := 0; -- V14
 
 lv_msg VARCHAR2(1000);
 lv_abort_flag VARCHAR2(1) := 'N';
 ln_rsm_units_cnt NUMBER;
--
BEGIN
 
 -- default message (EXTRACT MSG);
 lv_msg := 'Batch is submitted for extraction.';
 
 --program_name := 'sh /home/sbcsys/EXTRACT/RGPREXTR.sh';
 program_name := '/home/lIFetrak/lab/frmx'; --/RGPREXTR.x';

 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 -- Get the log file directory
 t_file_name := :control_block.result_parm_id || '_' || :control_block.chapter_id || '_' ||
 :control_block.contract_id || '_' || substr(to_char(v_local_date, 'hh24miss'), -4) || '.ext';


 BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc 
 INTO szExtrLoc 
 FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'LOGDR' AND 
 code = 'EXTRT' AND 
 ROWNUM =1 AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+10);
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 MESSAGE(SQLERRM||': Log directory is not mentioned');
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 

 -- SCR 19037 -- RSM report auto generation. This is used for both immediate and scheduled extract. -- IM 99
 IF NVL(:last.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN

 select to_char(systimestamp, 'SSFF2') into lv_pp_id
 from dual;

 fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_report_id := :control_block.contract_id || '_' || lv_pp_id; 
 lv_report_id := fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_report_id; 
 END IF; 

--
 IF NVL(:last.after_time, (v_local_date - 1)) > v_local_date 
 THEN -- Added by Arun on 02/07/2012
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, :last.after_time, v_after_time_gmt);
 ELSE
 v_after_time_gmt := :last.after_time;
 END IF;
 
 --initextract.schedule_extracts(t_file_name, v_after_time_gmt); -- Commented by Kishore on01/18/2012
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/27/2012. IM 7967
 begin
 insert into rgt_schedule_extract
 (file_name,
 extract_date_time,
 status,
 chapter_id,
 contract_id,
 result_parm_id,
 gen_report, -- SCR 19037
 report_id ) -- SCR 19037
 values
 (t_file_name,
 :last.after_time,
 null,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :control_block.contract_id,
 :control_block.result_parm_id,
 :last.rsm_auto_report, -- SCR 19037
 lv_report_id); -- SCR 19037
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;


 
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 -- End of change


 -- SCR 19037 -- RSM report auto generation -- IM 99
 IF NVL(:last.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 -- 1) initialize variables related to RSM report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.init(v_after_time_gmt); 
 lv_msg := 'Batch is submitted for extraction and RSM report is scheduled.';
 END IF; 
 
 ELSE
 --initextract.main_proc(t_file_name); -- Commented by Kishore on01/18/2012
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2012
 begin
 select to_char(systimestamp, 'SSFF2') 
 into t_pp_id
 from dual;
 end;
 
 rgprextr.main_program(:control_block.result_parm_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :control_block.contract_id,
 t_pp_id,
 t_status);
 
 if t_status is not null then
 message('Error: ' || t_status);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 
 -- SCR 19307 -- RSM AUTO REPORT GENERATION
 IF NVL(:last.rsm_auto_report,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 
 -- V14 (this table gets populated in RGPREXTR pkg)
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(unit_count,0), NVL(abort_flag, 'N') INTO unit_cnt , lv_abort_flag
 FROM rgt_result_parms
 WHERE result_parm_id = :control_block.result_parm_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 AND ROWNUM = 1; -- V15 (all the records will have same unit_cnt - pick any one record) 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 unit_cnt := 0;
 lv_abort_flag := 'N';
 END;
 -------------------------------- 
 
 IF unit_cnt <> 0 THEN
 lv_msg := 'Batch is submitted for extraction and RSM report is generated.';
 
 -- 1) initialize variables related to RSM report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.init;
 -- 2) call rsm_report.pop_table db routine. 
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.populate_table; 
 -- 3) Generate report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.generate;
 ELSIF unit_cnt = 0 AND lv_abort_flag <> 'Y' THEN 
 -- Scenario where unit count is 0 because the tests are set to not be in EFile. So, the lab file is not generated, but
 -- we still need to get the RSM report.
 -- Unit count will be zero for this scenario, so we need to run RSM pkg and check if there are any records.
 -- 1) initialize variables related to RSM report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.init;
 -- 2) call rsm_report.pop_table db routine. 
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.populate_table; 
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_rsm_units_cnt
 FROM rsm_report_details
 WHERE report_id = lv_report_id
 AND result_parm_id = :control_block.result_parm_id;
 
 IF ln_rsm_units_cnt <> 0 THEN
 lv_msg := 'Batch is submitted for extraction and RSM report is generated.';
 -- 3) Generate report.
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.generate; 
 ELSE
 -- 3) Delete report
 DELETE FROM rpt_parm WHERE parm_id = lv_report_id;
 COMMIT;
 END IF;

 END IF; 
 
 END IF;
 
 END IF;


 message(lv_msg, NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 
 /* Commented to avoid code redundancy SCR 18938
 -- timezone conversion starts
 IF is_timezone_enabled AND 
 :last.after_time IS NOT NULL 
 THEN

 SELECT SYSDATE 
 INTO v_sysdate 
 FROM dual;
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, v_sysdate, v_sysdate);

 IF :last.after_time > v_sysdate 
 THEN -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2011
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, :last.after_time, v_after_time_gmt);
 initextract.schedule_extracts(t_file_name, v_after_time_gmt); -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2011
 ELSE
 initextract.main_proc(t_file_name); 
 END IF;
 --- timezone conversion ENDs
 ELSE
 IF NVL(:last.after_time, (SYSDATE - 1)) > SYSDATE 
 THEN -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2011
 initextract.schedule_extracts(t_file_name, :last.after_time); -- Added by Kishore on 01/18/2011
 ELSE
 initextract.main_proc(t_file_name); 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 */

 --message('Batch is submitted for extraction'); -- IM 99
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 RAISE;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 Text_IO.Fclose (in_file); 
 MESSAGE (SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
END;

PROCEDURE gen_parmid 
IS
 temp_number NUMBER;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 
 IF :control_block.result_parm_id IS NULL
 THEN /*procedure called FROM more than one place to minimize locking time */
 
 -- get sequence
 DECLARE
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_cnt
 FROM number_generation
 WHERE chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 AND number_type = 'RESULT_BATCH_ID';
 
 IF ln_cnt = 0 THEN
 INSERT INTO number_generation 
 (
 chapter_id
 , number_type
 , max_number
 , last_reset_date
 )
 VALUES 
 (
 :control_block.chapter_id
 ,'RESULT_BATCH_ID'
 ,1
 ,trunc(SYSDATE));
 
 temp_number := 1; 
 ELSE
 temp_number := SBCLIB.GEN_SEQ('RESULT_BATCH_ID', :control_block.chapter_id);
 
 IF temp_number = 0 THEN
 MESSAGE('Something went wrong in generating Result Parm Id - SBCLIB.GEN_SEQ');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 
 :control_block.result_parm_id := 'R'||TO_CHAR(v_local_date,'YDDD')||LPAD(to_char(temp_number),3,'0');
 ----------
 
 -- check duplicate
 DECLARE
 lv_temp VARCHAR2(1);
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 'x'
 INTO lv_temp
 FROM
 rgt_result_parms
 WHERE
 result_parm_id = :control_block.result_parm_id
 AND chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id; 
 
 -- correct duplication found
 
 SELECT
 MAX(TO_NUMBER(substr(result_parm_id, 6))) + 1
 INTO temp_number
 FROM
 rgt_result_parms
 WHERE
 chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 AND result_parm_id LIKE 'R'
 || to_char(v_local_date, 'YDDD')
 || '%';--for update of result_parm_id;
 
 :control_block.result_parm_id := 'R'
 || to_char(v_local_date, 'YDDD')
 || lpad(to_char(temp_number), 3, '0');
 
 -- update sequence
 UPDATE number_generation
 SET
 max_number = temp_number
 WHERE
 chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 AND number_type = 'RESULT_BATCH_ID';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 END;



 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE gen_s_parmid 
IS
 temp_number NUMBER;
 v_temp VARCHAR2(5);
 v_date NUMBER;
 v_mod NUMBER;
 v_length NUMBER;
 v_value VARCHAR2(5);
 v_quo_value VARCHAR2(5);
 v_quo_length NUMBER;
 v_quo NUMBER;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 
 SELECT trunc((v_local_date - trunc(v_local_date, 'YYYY'))) + 1
 INTO v_date
 FROM DUAL
 ;
 
 v_quo := TRUNC(v_date / 36);
 v_quo_length := NVL(LENGTH(TO_CHAR(v_quo)), 0);
 
 IF v_quo_length> 1 
 THEN
 SELECT DECODE( v_quo, 10, 'A', 11, 'B', 12, 'C', 13, 'D', 14, 'E', 15, 'F', 16, 'G', 17, 'H', 18, 'I',
 19, 'J', 20, 'K', 21, 'L', 22, 'M', 23, 'N', 24, 'O', 25, 'P', 26, 'Q', 27, 'R',
 28, 'S', 29, 'T', 30, 'U', 31, 'V', 32, 'W', 33, 'X', 34, 'Y', 35, 'Z')
 INTO v_quo_value
 FROM DUAL
 ;
 ELSE
 v_quo_value := TO_CHAR(v_quo);
 END IF;
 
 v_mod := MOD(v_date, 36);

 v_length := NVL(LENGTH(TO_CHAR(v_mod)), 0);
 
 IF v_length > 1 
 THEN
 SELECT DECODE(v_mod, 10, 'A', 11, 'B', 12, 'C', 13, 'D', 14, 'E', 15, 'F', 16, 'G', 17, 'H', 18, 'I',
 19, 'J', 20, 'K', 21, 'L', 22, 'M', 23, 'N', 24, 'O', 25, 'P', 26, 'Q', 27, 'R',
 28, 'S', 29, 'T', 30, 'U', 31, 'V', 32, 'W', 33, 'X', 34, 'Y', 35, 'Z')
 INTO v_value
 FROM DUAL
 ;
 ELSIF v_length =1 
 THEN
 v_value := TO_CHAR(v_mod);
 END IF;
 
 v_temp := SUBSTR(LTRIM(:control_block.company), 1, 1); 
 
 IF :control_block.result_parm_id IS NULL
 THEN /*procedure called FROM more than one place to minimize locking time */
 -- get sequence
 DECLARE
 ln_cnt NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO ln_cnt
 FROM number_generation
 WHERE chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 AND number_type = 'RESULT_BATCH_ID';
 
 IF ln_cnt = 0 THEN
 INSERT INTO number_generation 
 (
 chapter_id
 , number_type
 , max_number
 , last_reset_date
 )
 VALUES 
 (
 :control_block.chapter_id
 ,'RESULT_BATCH_ID'
 ,1
 ,trunc(SYSDATE));
 
 temp_number := 1; 
 ELSE
 temp_number := SBCLIB.GEN_SEQ('RESULT_BATCH_ID', :control_block.chapter_id);
 IF temp_number = 0 THEN
 MESSAGE('Something went wrong in generating Result Parm Id - SBCLIB.GEN_SEQ');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;

 -- :control_block.result_parm_id := 'R'||to_char(SYSDATE,'YDDD')||lpad(to_char(temp_NUMBER),3,'0');
 :control_block.result_parm_id := v_temp||'R'||TO_CHAR(v_local_date,'Y')||v_quo_value||v_value||LPAD(TO_CHAR(temp_number),3,'0');


 -- check duplicate
 DECLARE
 lv_temp VARCHAR2(1);
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 'x'
 INTO lv_temp
 FROM
 rgt_result_parms
 WHERE
 result_parm_id = :control_block.result_parm_id
 AND chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id; 
 
 -- correct duplication found
 
 SELECT
 MAX(TO_NUMBER(substr(result_parm_id, 6))) + 1
 INTO temp_number
 FROM
 rgt_result_parms
 WHERE
 chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 AND result_parm_id LIKE v_temp|| 'R'||TO_CHAR(v_local_date,'Y')||v_quo_value||v_value||'%';
 
 :control_block.result_parm_id := v_temp||'R'||TO_CHAR(v_local_date,'Y')||v_quo_value||v_value||LPAD(TO_CHAR(temp_number),3,'0');
 
 -- update sequence
 UPDATE number_generation
 SET
 max_number = temp_number
 WHERE
 chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 AND number_type = 'RESULT_BATCH_ID';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

PACKAGE BODY fpk_rsm_auto_report IS
 /* SCR 19037 */
 PROCEDURE init(pl_start_time IN DATE) IS
 
 ld_sysdate DATE;
 --lv_pp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 
 PROCEDURE ins_upd_rpt_parm(pl_report_id IN VARCHAR2) IS
 ncount NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) INTO ncount 
 FROM rpt_parm 
 WHERE appl_id = gc_appl_id AND 
 user_name = gl_user AND 
 report_name = gc_rep_name AND 
 parm_id = pl_report_id;
 

 IF ncount = 0 THEN 
 INSERT INTO rpt_parm 
 (
 APPL_ID
 ,USER_NAME
 ,REPORT_NAME 
 ,PARM_ID 
 ,PARM_DATE 
 ,SUBMIT_DATE 
 ,REPORT_STATUS
 ,START_TIME
 ,CLIENT_MSG -- V04
 ,CLIENT_MSG_SENT -- V04
 )
 VALUES
 (
 gc_appl_id
 ,gl_user
 ,gc_rep_name
 ,pl_report_id
 ,SYSDATE
 ,SYSDATE
 ,'S' -- NULL -- IM 99 
 , pl_start_time
 , gl_filename -- V04
 ,NULL -- V04
 );
 ELSE
 UPDATE rpt_parm 
 SET submit_date = SYSDATE,
 report_status = 'S', -- IM 99 
 client_msg = gl_filename, -- V04
 client_msg_sent = NULL -- V04
 WHERE appl_id = gc_appl_id AND 
 user_name = gl_user AND 
 report_name = gc_rep_name AND 
 parm_id = pl_report_id;
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->1 :'||SQLERRM); PAUSE;
 END ins_upd_rpt_parm; 
 
 PROCEDURE ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in IN VARCHAR2, pselect_in IN VARCHAR2, pcode_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO rpt_parm_select
 (
 APPL_ID
 ,USER_NAME
 ,REPORT_NAME 
 ,PARM_ID 
 ,PARM_NO 
 ,PARM_SELECT 
 ,PARM_CODE 
 )
 VALUES
 (
 gc_appl_id
 ,gl_user
 ,gc_rep_name
 ,gl_report_id
 ,pno_in
 ,pselect_in
 ,pcode_in
 ); 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc--2 :'|| pcode_in || '-' ||SQLERRM);PAUSE;
 END ins_rpt_parm_select; 
 
 BEGIN
 
 -- 1) USER
 SELECT DECODE(SUBSTR(:banner.user_id, 1, 4) , 'OPS$', 
 SUBSTR(:banner.user_id, 5), :banner.user_id) 
 INTO gl_user
 FROM DUAL;
 
 -- 2) Contract ID
 gl_contract_id := :control_block.contract_id;
 
 
 -- 3) Result Parm ID
 gl_result_parm_id := :CONTROL_BLOCK.RESULT_PARM_ID;

 -- 4) File Name
 ld_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function
 gl_filename := gl_result_parm_id || '_' || gl_contract_id || '_' || TO_CHAR(ld_sysdate, 'MMDDHHMI') || '.pdf'; 
 

 -- Insert or Update rpt_parm
 ins_upd_rpt_parm(pl_report_id => gl_report_id); 
 
 -- 5) Chapter ID 
 gl_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID;
 
 
 -- Parameters 
 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '1', pselect_in => gl_result_parm_id, pcode_in => 'RPARM');

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '2', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'RBAT');
 gl_batch_id := 'ALL';
 
 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '3', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'RUNIT');
 gl_unit_id := 'ALL';

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '4', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'RTEST');
 gl_test_id := 'ALL';

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '5', pselect_in => 'ALL', pcode_in => 'REAC');
 gl_result_status := 'ALL';
 
 
 -- 11) -- Testing Facility.
 -- IM 99
 DECLARE
 CURSOR lab_id_cur IS
 SELECT vtl.testing_lab_id
 FROM master_codes mc, valid_testing_labs vtl
 WHERE mc.code_type = 'TLABS'
 AND mc.code = vtl.testing_lab_id
 AND vtl.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND ld_sysdate BETWEEN mc.eff_date AND NVL(mc.term_date, ld_sysdate+1)
 AND ld_sysdate BETWEEN vtl.eff_date AND NVL(vtl.term_date, ld_sysdate+1);
 
 l_lab_id VARCHAR2(10); 
 BEGIN 
 fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_testing_facility := NULL;
 
 OPEN lab_id_cur;
 FETCH lab_id_cur INTO fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_testing_facility;
 CLOSE lab_id_cur;
 
 IF fpk_rsm_auto_report.gl_testing_facility IS NULL THEN
 show_error('1069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 -- IM 99

 ins_rpt_parm_select(pno_in => '6', pselect_in => gl_testing_facility, pcode_in => 'LABID');

 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=10;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=0; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise;
 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('init -' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 100), NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 END init;


 PROCEDURE populate_table IS
 BEGIN
 -----------------------------------------------------
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 --
 -- Now Populate the RSM data tables
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 SYNCHRONIZE;

 rsm_report.pop_rsm_table

 PROCEDURE generate IS
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 
 --for Apps server 
 report_id Report_Object;
 ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
 vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
 vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
 
 -- Multiple reports server changes; -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
 -- End of change
 BEGIN

 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server(out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg);
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 
 
 
 
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 
 --Insert into RSM_RPT_PARM table
 INSERT INTO RSM_RPT_PARM(APPL_ID ,
 USER_NAME ,
 REPORT_NAME ,
 RESULT_PARM_ID ,
 REPORT_ID ,
 SUBMIT_DATE , 
 REPORT_STATUS ,
 REPORT_FILE_NAME ,
 PRINT_REQUEST_FLAG)
 VALUES (gc_appl_id, gl_user, gc_rep_name, gl_result_parm_id, gl_report_id, SYSDATE,'C',gl_filename, null);
 
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=10;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=0;
 
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(gc_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,gl_filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name); 
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');
 
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_report_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,nvl(gl_chapter_id,'WAD'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_TEST_LAB_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_testing_facility);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_report_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RESULT_PARM',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_result_parm_id);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.header_and_trailer_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(gc_rep_name));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(gl_user)); -- Added by Kishore on 05/16/2011
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_FILE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,gl_filename);
 
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2); -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 
 
 update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id = vjob_id,
 rep_server = l_svr_name -- Added by Kishore on 10/22/2013 
 where upper(report_name) = upper(gc_rep_name)
 and user_name = gl_user
 and parm_id = gl_report_id;
 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=15;
 COMMIT; 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=0;
 
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT'); 

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Report Generate - ' || SQLERRM );PAUSE; 
 
 END generate;

END fpk_rsm_auto_report;

PROCEDURE GO_QUERY IS
BEGIN
 
 go_block('batch');

 set_item_property('control_block.PB_BIPQ',enabled,property_true);

 then

 show_error('2184');
 else

 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 :units.arrow := '>';

from contracts 
where LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
and (upper(company) like upper('%'||:control_block.contract_id||'%') or (contract_id like '%'||:control_block.contract_id||'%'))

and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) 
between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) 
order by company

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code = 40501 
 then
 show_error('0292');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
